newsitem.title: USA: MECON sees flat to down Q3 before charge.
newsitem.headline: MECON sees flat to down Q3 before charge.

text.p: MECON Inc said on Monday it plans to take a one-time third-quarter restructuring charge of about $1.5 million, and forecast flat to lower results before the charge for the quarter ending December 31.

The charge is related to MECON's integration of its managed care information systems unit, centralization of management of its product development, sales and product support organizations, and increased investment in the development of new products.
MECON will also relocate its headquarters to larger facilities to accommodate the changes.

"The company expects that, as a result of reduced productivity during the implementation of the new corporate structure, earnings for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 ending December 31, 1996 (without taking into account the one-time charges), will be flat or down from earnings recorded for the third quarter of fiscal 1996 ended December 31, 1995," it said.
